subject: Verify TZ base branch and commit
command: git ls-remote --heads origin; git rev-parse feature/agod-instrumented-nes
finding: feature/agod-instrumented-nes resolves to 775aa68053c7b99bf699f16c1418b997ce507250, matching the TZ exactly; worktree clean
limitations: none

subject: AGOD standalone host checks
finding: all five AGOD checks pass at the base commit
limitations: host only; no Android, no blind ROM corpus

subject: Full project regression
finding: 115 PASS assertions, then stops at line 124 (fdb_game_check.cjs) because app/src/main/assets/lab/snes/core.js is absent
limitations: emscripten absent so SNES/GB retro cores cannot be built; 3 of 108 steps unrunnable here

subject: Steps after the blocker, run manually
finding: all 10 remaining non-retro steps pass
limitations: run outside check.sh with a cached org.json jar

subject: Reproduce TZ 2.1 AGOD coverage claims
finding: counter structural 7/7 and counter exact-typed 1/7 reproduce the TZ exactly; additionally lives exact-typed 7/7, fullTypeIdentified 0/7, verified rewards 0, independent confirmations 0, polarity unknown on all 7
limitations: synthetic controlled ROMs from the project's own generator, not blind commercial ROMs

subject: Reproduce TZ 2.2 trace claims and overhead
finding: parity counts reproduce exactly (32 ordered writes, 25 writer sites, 117 boundaries); host overhead does NOT reproduce stably: active p50 ratio 1.526 standalone vs 1.394 inside check.sh, detached 1.525 vs 1.285
limitations: 4-vCPU shared container; single runs, no repetition statistics

subject: Verify the four external SHAs named in the TZ
finding: all four SHAs exist in the named repositories
limitations: existence only; contents verified separately

subject: Resolve the real paths of the named mechanisms
finding: 2 of 4 paths implied by the TZ do not exist at the pinned SHA: rcheevos is src/runtime/rc_*.c (not src/rcheevos/*.c) and stable-retro is stable_retro/retro_env.py (package renamed). OCAtari's function lives in scripts/find_causative_ram_full.py. SB3 paths matched.
limitations: none

subject: License review of the four projects
command: fetch LICENSE at each pinned SHA
finding: all four are MIT; no incompatibility with GU (MIT); no code copied so no attribution obligation incurred yet
limitations: SPDX read from LICENSE text, no legal review

subject: Read SB3 DQN.train against the TZ's Double DQN requirement
finding: SB3's DQN.train at this SHA is VANILLA DQN: the TD target takes max over the target network, and the token 'double' does not occur in the file. NN-01 requires Double DQN, so that target must be written by GU and cannot be described as a port.
limitations: only dqn.py and buffers.py were read

subject: Read the reward source of Stable-Retro
finding: compute_step only delegates; reward and done come from a hand-written per-game scenario manifest (reward.variables/time/script, done.variables). This is per-ROM manual annotation, which 1.3 forbids as a product mechanism, but 11.2 permits for an independent oracle.
limitations: C++ read partially (loadReward/done paths)

subject: Read OCAtari find_causative_ram
finding: It is a RAM-write intervention probe: fixed-seed reset, ale.setRAM(i,v), one step, count changed pixel blocks vs baseline, keep addresses with 2..59 changed blocks. It intervenes on RAM, not on actions as AGOD-05 requires, needs arbitrary core RAM writes, carries a hardcoded game-specific setRAM(123,60), and establishes no goal or polarity.
limitations: upstream behaviour not reproduced; no differential test run

subject: Deterministic restore/replay precondition
command: scratch probe over jsnes toJSON/fromJSON on a controlled cartridge
finding: restore+replay is bit-identical for repeated neutral and repeated action arms, and the action arm differs from neutral; causal probing is therefore possible on this core
limitations: host only, one cartridge family

subject: Phase-shift confound in naive action-vs-neutral differencing
finding: Holding a button costs CPU time, the game loop misses a vblank and executes fewer iterations, so time-driven bytes are phase-shifted. reset held 12 frames produced exactly the neutral state at 11 frames (frameCounter 85, timer 5, noise 103). A naive difference would have claimed 101 false causal attributions of decoys across the 7 cartridges.
limitations: measured on the synthetic generator family

subject: Causal validation against the independent oracle
finding: 7/7 cartridges: score recovered from the positive button, lives from the negative button, menu from the menu button; all 8 buttons recovered via their own input-echo byte; 0 time-driven decoy attributions; 0 unwired buttons showing any effect beyond their own echo; 0 starts excluded as non-deterministic
limitations: synthetic controlled cartridges only, single-button masks held for the whole window, host only, no polarity/reward inferred, no blind corpus

subject: Resource depletion is observable without an oracle
finding: The negative button decrements lives 3->2->1->0, the value settles at a floor, and once depleted the positive button no longer changes the score. Loss of previously confirmed causal effects is the observable terminal signal.
limitations: one cartridge family

subject: Polarity induction and phase inference
finding: 7/7 cartridges: NEGATIVE polarity recovered for the correct button; 0/7 accumulators declared POSITIVE or promoted to VERIFIED (blocked by construction); PLAYING 7/7 and DEATH 7/7 recovered
limitations: synthetic cartridges; suppression is judged over a caller-supplied address scope because input echo never stops; separating input plumbing from game state generically is unsolved

subject: Verified reward broker and the UNKNOWN contract
finding: All 8 anti-reward-hacking cases of 6.3 behave as required plus 9 further cases (17 total). UNKNOWN packets carry no value key before or after a JSON round-trip. Intrinsic signals travel on a separate channel with no value key.
limitations: VERIFIED goals are supplied as fixtures: no registry exists yet to produce one, so G3 is advanced but not closed

subject: Evidence registry: a goal verified from its own disjoint holdout evidence
finding: 7/7 cartridges: the induced NEGATIVE goal reached VERIFIED from three independently run partitions (DISCOVERY/CALIBRATION/HOLDOUT, 2 starts each, 0 shared start keys) and the broker then paid out value -1. Negative controls on the same data: 0/7 accumulators verified, 0/7 verified when the holdout partition was rebuilt from discovery starts.
limitations: the three partitions come from one post-boot state at different neutral offsets (11/53/97): distinct parent states, but not independent play sessions; depletion is still driven by the checker using the oracle mask; TTL is a default, not a measurement

subject: Evidence registry: every shortcut to VERIFIED is refused
finding: 13/13 registry attacks refused by name: shared holdout start, renamed start (same parent state), restored-cache-only promotion, contradiction after verification, explicit contradiction, control episode as holdout, expired evidence, polarity not evidenced, polarity UNKNOWN, foreign profile revision, holdout without calibration, imported state from another ROM, no evidence at all.
limitations: in-memory persistence only; the start-key digest is stable, not cryptographic; no Layer Set format was touched

subject: Typed RAM field identification commits to one type
finding: 7/7 cartridges: the action-driven counter was typed correctly on its observed-active span, 6/7 also at its full declared width; lives typed exactly 7/7; counter encoding determined 7/7 and never claimed wrongly; signedness claimed 0 times (binary and two's complement have identical modular steps); lives encoding undetermined 0/7 by construction (every digit <=9 makes BCD and binary the same number). Baseline from logs/agod_rom_check.log: the exact typed counter spec was merely present in the candidate list on 1/7 and no type was ever selected (fullTypeIdentified is a constant false).
limitations: the only cartridge without full width is seed 7 (BCD, width 4, start 9): a carry into the upper bytes is unreachable in 150 events, so the low-order component is the honest answer; event sampling is supplied by the caller; role/polarity/meaning are not inferred; no visual HUD (AGOD-03); synthetic family only

subject: What the length-matched neutral control is worth
finding: Attributing simply 'bytes that changed while the action was pressed' makes the same identifier type 55 time-driven decoy fields as game variables across the 7 cartridges, typically one constant-step byte attributed to all eight buttons at once. With the neutral run of equal length and cadence as the control, that count is 0.
limitations: measured on the synthetic family; the control rules out time-driven bytes, not bytes driven by an action through a timer

subject: The learner is a learner: gradients, Double target, determinism, checkpoint
finding: Hand-written gradients match central finite differences to a maximum error of 5.4e-11 over every parameter. The Double DQN target differs from the vanilla one on a disagreement (-1.5197 vs -1.2109), and equals reward + gamma * target(s')[argmax online(s')] exactly. Identical seeds reproduce identical weights, different seeds do not. A checkpoint round-tripped through JSON continues to the same weights as an uninterrupted run (<1e-12), and a checkpoint of another shape is refused.
limitations: MSE loss (no clipping) so the finite-difference check has no kink to hide a wrong derivative; one hidden layer of 24 units; no hyperparameter search

subject: Behaviour changes only when the chain produced a VERIFIED reward
finding: 42 runs (7 cartridges x 6 agent seeds). The penalising button and the depleting resource were found without the oracle 42/42, and the goal reached VERIFIED through the registry on 7/7 cartridges. Frozen evaluation: penalised-action rate 0.000 trained, 0.508 untrained, 0.361 for a measured random policy; lives lost 0 vs 13.3 vs 15.3. Of the 4 of 6 agent seeds whose untrained policy chose the penalised action, 28/28 runs stopped choosing it, 0 got worse. Seed-independent form of the same result: Q(penalised) is the minimum of the three actions in 42/42 runs. The control performed 0 weight updates and received 0 payouts.
limitations: the untrained policy is cartridge-independent, so the control's effective sample size is 6 agent seeds and not 42 runs; three-action environment with scalar features, no pixels; the optimal policy is short; no published baseline was run; synthetic family only; Android untouched

subject: With only NEGATIVE reward available, only avoidance is learnable
finding: Among the two unpenalised actions - do nothing, or press the button that raises the counter - trained agents split 21/21. Nothing rewards scoring, because POSITIVE polarity is unprovable from inside the emulator (E4), so the agent is indifferent between scoring and standing still. It learned not to die and nothing else. UNKNOWN claims were never stored: 426-429 refusals per run went into no TD target, while 70-84 payouts did.
limitations: this is a property of the available reward, not of the learner; a positive objective needs the independent oracle of 11.2 or human labelling, neither of which exists
